items.question: Should I repair or replace a chip or crack?
items.answer: If it is a small chip or a small crack, we check it first and can usually fill and seal it before it spreads. When the damage is too large to repair, the replacement is arranged with a glass specialist we work with, with the glass ordered to your VIN.

items.question: How long does chip repair take?
items.answer: Most chips are fixed the same day. Vehicles come to the shop.

items.question: What if my chip cannot be repaired?
items.answer: We look at the chip first, because its size, location and condition decide whether it can be repaired. If it cannot, we can arrange a replacement with a glass specialist, with the glass ordered to your VIN and help with the insurance claim.
